newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's October tax revenues rise - minister.
newsitem.headline: Russia's October tax revenues rise - minister.

text.p: Russia's tax revenues rose to 13.5 trillion roubles in October, 3.5 trillion roubles more than in September, Itar-Tass news agency quoted Finance Minister Alexander Livshits as saying on Tuesday.
The government has been acutely concerned about tax collection since the International Monetary Fund, worried about poor tax revenues, delayed payment of the next tranche of a $10 billion loan.
An IMF mission will come to Moscow in November.
The government said previously it had received 74 percent of budgeted taxes in the first nine months of 1996.
